prompts.closed:

Image 1 is the base sleeve design. Image 2 supplies the EXACT interlocking LA monogram and cotton-stock card texture. Image 3 is the real portrait. Target logical viewport 390 x 844 CSS px, rendered high-resolution at approximately 853 x 1844. Preserve the tall aspect ratio. Entire image is website content, no phone bezel, notch, OS status, browser chrome, annotation, or comparison collage.
PRIMARY DESIGN: Retain the blush pink page, dusty rose physical paper sleeve with its semicircular notch and folded seams, cream upright personal card tucked into the sleeve, warm dark-plum text, centered name and soft stationery mood of image 1. Beautiful deliberate skeuomorphism. The user has selected this design.
TRANSFER FROM IMAGE 2 EXACTLY:
1. Interlocking elegant serif LA monogram: the tall L begins slightly above the A; the horizontal FOOT OF THE L EXTENDS THROUGH THE MIDDLE OF THE A at its crossbar height. The letters overlap and interlock, not side-by-side LA, not a generic font ligature. Faithfully match the actual visible interlocking mark in reference image 2.
2. Use this identical monogram as the dark-plum printed page logo at top left, about 32x38 logical px, and as a subtle ivory-on-ivory BLIND EMBOSSED relief on the card at its upper-right, about 37x43 logical px. Relief catches light at raised edges, do not simply print the card logo in gray. The same crossing shape must be identifiable in both places.
3. Give the cream business card the noticeably rich COTTON / LETTERPRESS texture of image 2: visible irregular paper fibers, gentle pressed-in ink, substantial fine paper edge, natural softly raking light. Keep readable text high-contrast. Sleeve remains dusty rose matte paper. Background less textured than card so the card stands out.
MOBILE LAYOUT at 390x844 logical px:
Header roughly y=25-60. Interlocking dark-plum logo left x=24; small "SACRAMENTO, CA" right.
Physical object roughly x=30..360 and y=90..500. Upright cream card extends from y=85, 282px wide, peeking from sleeve. Faithfully reuse real portrait as a 90px rounded-square photo near upper center with space for the embossed monogram upper-right. Under portrait elegant dark-plum serif "Luis Augusto" in two lines, with smaller readable "Product & Growth" and "Engineering". Do not hide role with the sleeve notch.
Dusty rose sleeve overlaps only lower card section, from around y=335 to y=500. Front of sleeve says large lowercase "hello." and small "A card from Luis". The sleeve is shorter and more refined than reference 1 to save vertical space. An unobtrusive "Lift card" plus small upward arrow is PRINTED INSIDE THE SLEEVE at its lower-right; reserve a 44px-high tap zone. It is a quiet text action on the physical sleeve, NOT a separate raised pill below. Keep enough bottom padding for the control.
REDESIGN THE ENTIRE AREA BELOW THE SLEEVE:
Everything aligns to ONE consistent x=24 left edge and x=366 right edge, width 342px. Remove the centered vertical pile of different-size buttons. No centered standalone email squeezed between actions.
After a comfortable 28px gap, one neat TWO-COLUMN row of equal-sized download actions, each about 165px wide x 52px high, with a 12px gap. LEFT: deep plum softly rounded rectangle, small download icon and readable exact label "Save contact". RIGHT: standard black "Add to Apple Wallet" badge in its native landscape proportions, overall same width and height as left button. Same top, bottom, and baseline alignment. Do not stretch the Wallet symbol or rearrange the standard badge. Do not turn these into full-width vertically stacked buttons.
24px below the download row, a single full-width contact row, about 52px high, with a small envelope icon, left-aligned "hello@luis.app" at readable 16px, and small diagonal arrow aligned at far right. Use a fine full-width divider beneath. This row is on the base pink page, not another raised card or pill.
Below that, a clean 48px-high row with THREE EQUAL WIDTH text-link cells reading "GitHub", "LinkedIn", "Writing", each with a tiny diagonal arrow. All left-aligned within their cell, common baseline; no floating icons above labels, no three different-size buttons, no separate Email link because the full-width email row already serves it. Light small separators optional, no heavy boxes.
All copy legible at actual phone size. At most two font families. Plenty of subtle breathing room but no wasted half-screen area. No extra feature cards, fake articles, statuses, claims or dates. Full page finishes comfortably inside viewport. One clear card hero and calm purposeful action hierarchy. Preserve correct portrait identity, both specified LA marks, cream paper tactile quality, and accessible contact actions. This is the CLOSED / IN-SLEEVE state only.
